messages:
Ravi: FYI team  new release: Tenant Key-Proofing and Customer Verification APIs for Private/VPC. This gives customers a signed, time-bound proof of key wrapping for audits and supports third-party KMS attestations. Docs + quickstart: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-keyproof
Kim: Important: this is opt-in for existing tenants but enabled-by-default on new Private deployments. No customer data movement required.
Carmen: Ops note: enabling will add a small additional header to audit bundles (key_proof_sig) and a signed metadata file. No service downtime expected. Enable CLI example: redwoodctl private keyproof enable --tenant acme-test --prove-kms true
Compliance: For customers with external auditors, the signed proof contains the wrapping_key_id, timestamp, nonce, and signature. Proofs are rotated with key rotations automatically. We validated signature format against our major auditors last week.
SEs: Please surface any accounts that will need a copy of historical proofs for audits; we currently only generate proofs at rotation time. We have a migration helper to retroactively generate proofs for prior rotations (see runbook).
Ops Bot: scheduled-canary -> group: keyproof-canaries-6 at 23:00 UTC; health-checks: signature-verify latency and verification success rate. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/logs/rollout/4387650000
Ravi: Action items: 1) Eng/Ops: watch canary and set a P50/P95 for signature verification latency. 2) SEs: collect a short list of auditors that require raw proofs. 3) Compliance/Legal: review customer-facing audit language.
Kim: TL;DR: Key-Proofing API live as opt-in today for Private/VPC; new tenants get it on by default. No downtime; generates signed proofs for auditors and supports attested KMS providers. Post any blockers here. :lock:
